senses.gloss: f. pl. (dominicae, sub aedes, v. Revue des Etudes Juives, 1884, p. 277) churches.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 74b:6">Snh. 74ᵇ</cite> <he>הני קווקי וד׳ היכי יהבינן להו נורא</he> Ms. M. (ed. omit. <he>נורא</he>; Var. lect., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) how dare we give fire to those churches (on Sundays)? [<cite ref="S00266"><he>קווקי</he></cite>, <he>קוואקי</he> &c., misnomer of κυριακή, the name used by the Greek teachers of Christianity, corresp. to the Latin dominica.—For another explan. v. Revue des Etudes Juives 1885, p. 195 sq.]
